retrieval_policy.current_unit_dependency_rule: The kickoff must remain completable using only manager-authored local material and standard local Rust tooling.
later_job_rules: Retrieve only material explicitly authorized for that job and permitted by its access and license terms.
Never fetch or expose secrets, private or authentication-gated content, paywalled text, hidden graders, sealed references, or another learner's files.
Pin repositories or documents to an immutable revision when possible and record source URL, revision, retrieval result, checksum, and license.
Classify a linked index separately from the lessons or assignments it names.
Record failures, missing items, region or account restrictions, and partial retrieval without substituting inferred content.
Promote no resource record to an official unit until identity, order, dependencies, availability, and provenance have been verified.
retrieval_policy.on_unavailable: Leave the material blocked, preserve its locator and reason, and design no required learner task that depends on it.
